notes.title: v1.1.0 "Finale Update" Out Now!
notes.content:
[p]For a little bit now, I've been teasing that I've been working on a new content update for the game.[/p][p]
It is now released![/p][p]You can play it right now! Yes, even you Demo users out there can.[/p][p]I know I previously kinda dropped support for the Demo but I have updated the Demo this time as well, which means Demo users now [i]also[/i] have all previous updates as well.[/p][p][/p][p]The Changelog in this update is far bigger than all previous updates as this is the first major content update. I'm just gonna let it speak for itself.[/p][p][/p][p]Additions:[/p][p] - You can now unlock Stars on the Title Screen to indicate what I consider to be this game's "end-game"/"post-game accomplishments.[/p][p] - The door in Tobias Lehnen's hideout now opens once you have achieved 1 star.[/p][p] - Tobias Lehnen's Medicalean in Tobias' hideout now has the visual effect when Tobias Lehnen's Medicalean is unlocked.[/p][p] - Added 2 Easter Egg voicelines[/p][p] - The in-room text now changes periodically.[/p][p] - New Rare Event added.[/p][p] - Added a reminder on the Pause Screen on how to return to the Main Menu.[/p][p] - Added an extra decal to the Main Menu room.[/p][p] - New "Lean Leak" visuals for a more dynamic environment.[/p][p] - Added unlockable Leak Skins.[/p][p] - Added a new screen shake effect for the Lean Stare effect while you're Addicted.[/p][p] - Added an Easter Egg for a certain day.[/p][p] - Gaining 100% Achievements now shows teasers for my next game project.[/p][p] - Added a new option to disable those annoying pop-ups that appear every time you gain an Achievement.[/p][p] - Added a new Cheat Code to see my next game Teasers early.[/p][p] - Added "Flashing Lights" to the warning splash.[/p][p] - Added a new light to the wall between the Extras & Changelog for consistency.[/p][p] - You can now shatter the monitor in the Main Menu room.

[/p][p]Changes:[/p][p] - Secret Boss aerial attack nerf - Death only occurs after the  drop animation has completed.[/p][p] - Secret Boss trap attack buff - Can now trigger even if you cannot afford it.[/p][p] - Secret Boss now takes x2 damage from Special Lean Types[/p][p] - Secret Boss aerial attack nerf - Drop animation is slightly slower.[/p][p] - Goldean Monster Boss now renamed to "Emily Tauren"[/p][p] - Emily Tauren has now been remodelled and reposed to be more unique.[/p][p] - Made the Lean pop effect a bit juicier, louder sound effect and brighter lighting. [/p][p] - Capped the Opening-Storage-Gate particle effect to 60fps. I suspect this might fix the issue of people not seeing it on  higher framerates, but I can't test that to know for sure.[/p][p] - Adjusted the ceiling on the title room & the hallway to fit the room spaces better.[/p][p] - Demo version number now uses the full game's numbering scheme for consistency. It was weird before because the Demo released BEFORE the main game did, so it used the Beta numbering system instead.[/p][p] - Adjusted the PTSD skip Cheat Code to align with the new Stars.[/p][p] - Tobias Lehnen's Medicalean has been rebalanced to no longer  have an area-of-effect.[/p][p] - Changed the light in the Extras Menu to be more consistent with the light in the Changelog.[/p][p] - Infinitean's Glossary Entry updated.[/p][p] - Rainbow Leansplosion Effect colour cycles are no longer frame-rate dependent, aligning with other rainbow colour cycles.[/p][p] - Moved the Achievements Menu elements slight to fit better on more common screen resolutions.[/p][p] - Hitting Escape while in the Maintenance Hatch now exits the Hatch rather than Pausing. It's more intuative to a lot of players to hit Escape to exit these sort of things.[/p][p]	[/p][p]Fixes:[/p][p] - The minutes of the time in Tobias Lehnen's hideout is now always in double digits.[/p][p] - The Cuboids of Lean on the title screen now move the correct speed on different framerates.[/p][p] - Fixed a broken light when using one of the game's Cheats.[/p][p] - Fixed the Cheat Menu's letter cycling not working properly on higher framerates.[/p][p] - Fixed bug where getting Jumpscared while entering the Maintenance Hatch caused the wrong camera position.[/p]

notes.title: Upcoming "Finale Update" Announcement & Details!
notes.content:
[p]It's been a while since I've said anything about this game, but I wanted to say that part of the reason why is because this next update is going to be a bigger one.[/p][p][/p][p]Unlike the previous updates, this is not a bug fix update (I mean, there are a few bug fixes, but it's not the main focus), this is a CONTENT update.[/p][p]New stuff is being added into the game.[/p][p]
Sporting the biggest most interesting changelog so far out of any of the previous updates.

Some new features include:[/p][list][*][p]Totally new story elements (something better than just flat text in a menu or a wall).[/p][/*][*][p]General improvements to the game's atmosphere, such as new visuals and audio.[/p][/*][*][p]Secret Bossfight (already in the game) being rebalanced so that it is no longer a total pain in the lean.[/p][/*][*][p]A new type of collectable to go for related to features later on in the game.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Oh and of course the very thing the update is named after, a new sequence at the "end" of the game, giving the game a true "Finale" and a Secret Ending to potentially aim towards.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]I hope there are some people out there who look forward to seeing this game get a bit more to it. It's not a fundamentally different game or anything, but there's a little more to do and it's generally a better experience I think. [/p]

notes.title: Release v1.0.5 Patch Note
notes.content:
Previously, 10 of the in-game Achievements were not counted for the Completion % on the Profiles Menu, this has now been fixed.

Also I've returned the Demo to the Steam Page.
A lot more people played the Demo and it's more important to me that more people play the game than only a few people paying for it, so the Demo is back.

Keep in mind, it's the same Demo as from pre-release (Beta 4 I think?) as I don't want to keep 2 versions of the game up-to-date but I still hope people are happier with being able to play this version of the game again.

Edit bc I forgor: Another Story: Michelle has been made less accessible.
It still exists, but you now have to run it directly from the game's directory rather than from the Steam Client.
Mainly, I just don't think anyone would actually want to play it, and so in practice it just adds an extra unnecessary step to running the base game (selecting LeanSimD rather than Another Story).

notes.title: Release v1.0.4 Patch Notes
notes.content:

notes.title: Release v1.0.2 & v1.0.3 Patch notes
notes.content:

notes.title: UPCOMING CONTENT SHOWCASE - NEXT FEST FINAL DAY
notes.content:
So it turns out due to timezones, I'm actually pretty sure this stream will be my last stream for Next Fest.

I wanted to do something a bit cooler than just "continuing the full play-through" so in this broadcast, I will be primarily playing the game to showcase upcoming features that I am working on that will be coming to the full version of the game.

I'll aim to have the following features will be showcased:
 - The final Special Lean Type (2 others that will also be exclusive to the full game have already been showcased)
 - Some post-game content
 - The Extras Menu (already showcased to an extent, but I'll be covering it more in-depth)

notes.title: Demo v2.0.19 Patch
notes.content:
Y'all not gonna believe this, but I fixed a spelling error.

Fixed the spelling of "Tutorial" specifically, as it was previously "Tutourial".

notes.title: Demo v2.0.18 Patch
notes.content:
Cut Content:
1) Removed the ability to make the game's volume louder.
 - This is because I noticed that increasing the volume past the intended volume causes the audio to distort really badly. The BGM was especially absolutely horrible. I don't want people playing the game at that audio quality. 

Changes:
1) The Unlock Hint for the Gold Key has been changed to be more marginally more helpful
2) The Gold Key is now actually Gold.
3) The Gold Key is now moved somewhere more appropriate.
4) The pulsing effect on the Game Over screen is now more subtle, I thought it was too fast before.
5) The Upgrade Interface Brightness now differs between Brightness settings to be easier to look at on those settings.

Bug Fixes:
1) Fixed the Dehydration/Addiction effects not properly fitting the screen.
2) Fixed the Lean Stare Audio not stopping when it was supposed to. Hopefully. 
Truthfully, that audio file for some reason has been a big pain ever since it was implemented, so ngl I kinda expect the bug to still be there. Hopefully it isn't tho.

notes.title: Demo 2.0.17 Patch
notes.content:
Changelog:
1) Tutourial screenshots now use screenshots from the latest version of the game for consistency.
2) Lots of changes regarding the lore text for foreshadowing and clarification.

Lore Text Notes:
 - Removed the "I'm Sorry" lore text, as it too heavily implied The Writer had a larger role
 - Changed "The E.P.P. used Delivery #12" lore text to be more specific.
 - Changed "The Source is The E.P.P.'s Creation" lore text to make it sound less deliberate.
 - All mentions of "The Project" are now switched out with "The E.P.P." for consistency. Using different language too heavily implied they were different things.
 - Changed "Tobias Lehnen is not one of them" line for consistency

Other Note:
I also updated the Steam screenshots to be accurate to the current version.

Edit: Not really considering this another update since the change was so small and was done so soon after this build first went up, but the camera in Tobias Lehnen's Hideout is now also up-to-date.

notes.title: Demo 2.0.16 Patch

2) Added Credits for the 3D model added last update, as I forgot to before and that's really important and is the main reason I pushed this update.
3) Added some text telling you that you can allocate PTSD to the Bonuses, as most players didn't seem to notice that.

Changes:
1) Moved the black barrier used to emulate the lights going out.

 - I'm unsure if you can even tell in-game but I just noticed and thought that should be adjusted

Slight Tangential Note:
I want to update the cover art of the game soon to make it more visually striking so if you notice it suddenly changes to something significantly brighter, that is why.

notes.title: Demo 2.0.15 Patch
notes.content:
After reviewing some footage (thanks btw for streaming and recording my game!), quite a few fixes and tweaks have been made.

Additions:
1) You can now see what the Lean Machean's Stability is at the Lean Machean itself. This is to make it easier to see when the Lean Machean destabilises. Now you can really see how dodgy it is!
2) Added an object that has a 10% chance of appearing per run. Not going to spoil what it is. Just trust me. It's awesome.

Changes:
1) "Find The Key" is replaced with "Requires Key" to keep consistency with the Lean Storage. The original line also too heavily implied that they Key was something you actively needed to seek out, which isn't really the case.
2) Shortened the amount of time you stare at the Cuboid of Lean during the "Lean Stare" effect of getting too addicted to Lean. It could previously be as long as 3 seconds, which felt wayyy too long imo. Now it can only last for half a second max.
3) Halved the Price for the Fix Machean Stability option in the Upgrade Interface. This is to make repairing the Machean less brutal in the early game. 
4) As a result of adding the new Lean Machean Stability indicator, the Lean Storage Gate Key has been moved. 

Bug Fixes:
1) Fixed a bug where the Destabilise Grace Period never ended if you held down the Lean Machean button. 
I.e. You used to be able to hold the Lean Machean button down and the Stability would never deplete. That is no longer the case and has been fixed.
2) Fixed a bug caused by last patch where the "Click to Continue" button continued past the Highscore Menu before you even got the chance to Input you name.
3) Fixed a bug where you get given a free Glossary Entry immediately.
Note: This doesn't matter too much for now as the Glossary Menu is not in the Demo.
4) Fixed a bug where your Highscore Name would be "AAA", even if you input your own name.

notes.title: Demo v2.0.14 Patch
notes.content:
Changelog:
1) Darkened the Upgrade Interface background slightly, just wanted to make it ever so slightly less of a flashbang.
2) You can now use the Mouse on the Game Over screen, this is to keep consistency with the rest of the game - Specifically the Scoreboard Name Input screen.
3) The "Loading..." Text now properly appears when loading the Title Screen from the Scoreboard Menu
